patch_description:
The recommendation and prior results show that:
1. Pure Ising gates (XX, YY, ZZ) for all two-qubit entanglement improve worst-group margin
2. Parameter count matters significantly - fewer distinct parameters consistently score higher
3. The best prior score (0.59) achieved this with 10 distinct parameters

Current program has 12 distinct parameters with multiple RZ post-rotation variants. I will:
1. Consolidate rz_post_even and rz_post_odd back to a single rz_post parameter
2. This reduces from 12 to 11 distinct parameters while maintaining the Ising-only gate structure
3. This pattern aligns with the seed program (score 0.57) which used a single rz_post parameter

The consolidation trades some expressiveness for parameter efficiency, which the metrics show is strongly rewarded in the scoring function.
